question: The 17th edition of the India–Mongolia joint military exercise “Nomadic Elephant” in 2025 was conducted at which location?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The 17th edition of the **India–Mongolia joint military exercise**, called "**Nomadic Elephant**", was conducted in **2025** at **Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia**.
 
• This exercise aims to strengthen the **defense cooperation** between **India** and **Mongolia**.
 
• The focus of this joint exercise is on **counter-terrorism operations**, enhancing **inter-operability**, and exchanging **best practices** between the two nations' armed forces.
 
• **Ulaanbaatar** is the capital city of **Mongolia** and serves as a hub for various **international collaborations**, including defense cooperation.
 
• The exercise also highlights the **shared values** and **commitment** of the two nations towards **regional security** and **peace**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Umroi, Meghalaya**__

 __
 
• **Umroi** is a location in the **Meghalaya** state of India known for hosting several **military training exercises**.
 
• It serves as a base for **joint military drills** due to its terrain resembling varied operational environments.
 
 
 
• **Leh, Ladakh**__
 __
 
• **Leh** is a high-altitude region in the Indian Union Territory of **Ladakh**.
 
• It is often chosen for **mountain warfare training** and exercises due to its **rugged terrain** and **extreme climatic conditions**.
 
 
 
• **Tawang, Arunachal Pradesh**__
 
 
• **Tawang** is a strategic location in the northeastern state of **Arunachal Pradesh**, near the **India-China border**.
 
• This region has significant **geopolitical importance** and is occasionally used for **military drills** and **defense operations**.
